claim_map.title: Existing payment-type rules
claim_map.text: The Day2 design uses separate Coupon and Interim MTM rules. Their keys include booking entity, counterparty, currency, value date, and payment type. Netting ID must be empty. Coupon and MTM must not net together. Initial and Final Notional remain excluded. Use the parent trade clearing organization and external trade identifiers from the documented parent/Murex fields. Retry a failed job after 30 minutes. Suppressed cashflows do not feed LMS.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.

claim_map.title: Selected-client enhancement
claim_map.text: The enhancement targets selected clients and CCS principal settlement. Murex identifies strategy SWAP_AGENT; Stella requires SwapAgentID. The proposed rule has no currency filter. It allows cross-payment-type and cross-Murex/Stella netting in this selected scope. The unchecked payment-type list does not establish approval for every entry. SwapAgentNetting has priority above SALMTM. The job time is VD 01:00 GMT. Suppress singleton and resultant SWIFT. Exclude these selected clients from old SAL rules; retain old SAL rules for other clients. Missing-indicator risk is a design concern, without inspected release evidence.
claim_map.confidence: high for bounded source-specific wording; current applicability unresolved
claim_map.rationale: Selected original text explicitly supplies this rule or labelled proposal; competing scope and omissions remain stated.
